stem: A primary pathogen differs from an opportunistic pathogen how?

options.label: A
options.text: Causes disease even when host defenses are intact
options.misconception: None; primary pathogens can cause disease in intact hosts.
options.explanation: OpenStax: primary pathogen causes disease regardless of microbiota/immune system.

options.label: B
options.text: Causes disease only after ACE-inhibitor drug dosing
options.misconception: Pharm distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong framing; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: C
options.text: Exists only as a rejected null-hypothesis claim
options.misconception: Stats distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong domain; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: D
options.text: Infects only chloroplasts inside living plant cells
options.misconception: Botany distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Wrong domain; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: E
options.text: Colonizes humans only after statin therapy begins
options.misconception: Pharm distractor — does not match the cited teaching point.

context: Learning objective: primary vs opportunistic pathogens.
